main_body: Large round leafy canopy (rows 0-55) on a brown trunk with root flare (rows 47-78)
top_band: Canopy top: lit mid/light greens in the upper clumps rows ~2-12 (lighter foliage on top, darker below); organic tree, no flat rim
evidence: The tree is an organic canopy of rounded clumps lit from above, with darker undersides of the clumps and shadow under the canopy over the trunk. The clump tops read as lit surfaces above shaded faces. The trunk is a vertical column with a root flare. It is a standard 3/4 tree rather than a flat elevation, with no isometric side faces.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 greens in per-clump highlights and dark pockets, with dark green outlines next to the leaves and dark brown beside the trunk. The trunk has grain in 4 or more browns plus a root flare. Per-tile density matches or exceeds the references. There are no large flat fills. It is a little more uniform and rounder than the reference, but it holds up beside it.
